summary: Ubuntu 14.10 (Utopic Unicorn) was released on 23 October 2014. Features: Unity 8 (converged desktop/phone UI) in development, improved multi-monitor support, AppArmor improvements. Focus on preparing for convergence with Ubuntu Touch. The unicorn symbolized the aspirational, almost mythical goal of a unified experience across devices.
notes: Unsupported since 2015-07-23. Kernel 3.16. Unity 8 and convergence were later abandoned when Canonical pivoted away from phones.
